variants.note: Full-height fir with three broad tiers of boughs, exposed lower trunk and a flared root seat; keep small gaps between foliage masses.
Young fir with fewer bough tiers, a slim taper and a visible trunk, redrawn at its smaller size rather than scaled from the tall tree.
Asymmetric fir with the upper branches swept to one side and a broken top; retain a rooted base and a dark lee-side mass.
Fir boughs carrying broad warm-lit snow caps over cool green undersides; the snow changes the drawn state, not the solid footprint.
